note: Curated registry of authoritative Nepali sources. Membership here is what makes a source 'official' — domain TLD alone (org.np/edu.np) is NOT sufficient. Verify each entry before setting verified=true, and re-check periodically.

sources.title: Official passport information: fees, procedures, appointment booking
sources.notes: Primary source for passport fees, required documents, and appointment flow.

sources.title: Police clearance reports, crime reporting, public notices
Consolidated Nepal laws, acts, regulations (कानूनको आधिकारिक संकलन)
sources.notes: Canonical text of current acts and rules. Prefer over unofficial law aggregators.

sources.title: PAN/VAT registration, tax filings, taxpayer services

sources.title: Citizenship acts, directives, ministry notices
